desc: Parse N and the N×N grid; build per-label in_mask/out_mask bitsets for predecessor x→v and successor v→y.
Initialize ans to -1, set diagonal 0 and single-edge 1 states, enqueue them, tracking unvisited_rows.
Run multi-source BFS on pair states extending by matching label c on both ends, setting ans[x][y]=d+2.
Output N rows space-separated; verified against both public samples (PASSED).
Confirmed bitset BFS is correct and efficient for N≤100; no fallback needed.
